Mitutoyo Rockwell Hardness Testing Machine HR-530 Series 
$16,168.05 – $19,437.00
Mitutoyo Rockwell Hardness Testing Machine HR-530 Series Unique electronic control makes the HR-530 series of hardness testers capable of Rockwell, Rockwell Superficial, Rockwell testing of plastics
(A & B) and Light Force Brinell hardness testing. The closed loop test force control on the Mitutoyo HR-530 Rockwell and Brinell Hardness Tester allows for a wide variety of hardness testing including plastics. The HR-530 is capable of testing the inside wall hardness of rings without cutting the ring into pieces. An easy to use brake-start system automatically begins testing when initial force is reached.
HR-530 (810-237 IS NOW 810-233-23A  ) Maximum specimen size: Height 250 mm, Depth 150 mm
NOTE: WE HAVE ONE 810-237 DEMO MODEL IN STOCK FOR $ 15,900  The change here was to add a kit of accessories that were all ASTM compliant.  Now the accessory test blocks and indenters are sourced in the US and meet ASTM requirement with new 810-233-23A  Our demo unit 810-237 won’t have these accessories, it has blocks and indenters that were made at Mitutoyo Japan. However, we can quote ands supply USA made test blocks and indenters if required. ,
HR-530 Max sample height is 9.8″
HR-530L Maximum specimen size: Height 15.5″ Depth 150 mm (810-337 IS NOW 810-333-23A )
Includes Mitutoyo field service installation and calibration
Read More
Mitutoyo Rockwell Hardness Testing Machine HR-530 Series Features:
The curved surface correction function enables curved surfaces, such as round bars and spheres, to be tested for hardness as easily as flat surfaces
Color touch screen control panel displays statistics and graphs; up to five display formats show needed information
Nose-type indenter enables measurement of a specimen’s flat top surface as well as inside surface of cylindrical specimen
The HR-530 is available in 9.8” (250mm) or 15.5” (395mm) height capacity models
Complete with a combination diamond indenter, a 1/16” carbide ball indenter, one flat and one V anvil, 2 HRC, 1 HRBW, 1 HR30TW and 1 HR30N test block
Hardness testing of plastics according to ASTM D785 (Procedure A and B) and ISO2039-2 are also possible
